scope: outdoor transfer connectors; indoor transfers remain walking

selection_policy.headline: Actual elapsed travel time includes all walking, riding, handling and waiting.
selection_policy.preference: Balanced recommendation considers walking and transfers; a slightly faster full-bike alternative does not force it ahead of a simpler transit trip.
selection_policy.preview_behavior: Do not replace an inspected route; label the fresh recommendation and allow explicit refresh.
selection_policy.full_list: All retained distinct reasonable verified candidates; rendered lazily.

limits: This is a bounded candidate search, not a proof of the global mathematical optimum.
Only data-backed current services and confirmed street paths are offered.
Bike and dock availability is current, not reserved for arrival.
Hosted routing fixtures explicitly control supply and geometry where necessary; they are not historical live observations.
Simulator checks do not establish physical-device frame rate.

additional_cases: Same route with substantially different boarding tradeoffs stays visible
